plan.title: Authentication System — JWT, User Registration, Admin Management

task.description: Create auth service modules: jwt.py (python-jose: create_access_token, create_refresh_token, verify_token with HS256, configurable expiry from settings), password.py (argon2-cffi: hash_password, verify_password — no passlib wrapper), middleware.py (get_current_user from JWT Bearer header, require_admin dependency). Wire get_current_user and require_admin into dependencies.py exports. Create auth Pydantic schemas: LoginRequest, LoginResponse (access_token, refresh_token, user), RegisterRequest, ChangePasswordRequest, RefreshRequest, UserResponse, SessionResponse.
task.verification: JWT round-trip: create → verify succeeds. argon2-cffi hash → verify succeeds. get_current_user rejects invalid tokens. require_admin rejects non-admin users.
task.done-condition: Auth service modules importable and unit-testable in isolation

dimension.name: testing
dimension.rationale: Unit tests only at this stage

task.description: Create auth API endpoints (9 total): POST /api/v1/auth/register (first user = admin, subsequent blocked when allow_registration=false), POST /api/v1/auth/login (returns tokens + user, sets must_change_password flag), POST /api/v1/auth/refresh (rotate refresh token, hash stored in sessions table), POST /api/v1/auth/change-password (requires current password), GET /api/v1/auth/me (returns user profile), PATCH /api/v1/auth/me (update email, display_name, title), PATCH /api/v1/auth/me/avatar (stub — returns 501 for Phase 1), GET /api/v1/auth/sessions (list active sessions), DELETE /api/v1/auth/sessions/{id} (revoke session, cannot revoke own current session). Thin route handlers calling service functions. Register creates vault directory at {vault.base_path}/private/{username}/.
task.verification: Register → login → refresh → change-password flow completes. First user gets admin role. Subsequent register blocked. must_change_password flag returned correctly. Session revocation works.
task.done-condition: All 9 auth endpoints functional, first-user admin bootstrap works, refresh token rotation stores hash in sessions table

dimension.name: scope
dimension.rationale: 1 file but 9 endpoints with distinct logic

dimension.name: integration
dimension.rationale: JWT, argon2, sessions table, vault directory creation

dimension.name: risk
dimension.rationale: Auth security, first-user bootstrap is tricky

dimension.name: decomposability
dimension.rationale: 9 endpoints are individually testable but share auth state

task.description: Create admin user management endpoints: GET /api/v1/admin/users (list with stats), POST /api/v1/admin/users (create user with auto-generated temp password, must_change_password=true, create vault directory), PATCH /api/v1/admin/users/{id} (update role/email, cannot change own role, username immutable), POST /api/v1/admin/users/{id}/reset-password (generate temp password, shown once), DELETE /api/v1/admin/users/{id} (requires typed username confirmation, deletes DB records NOT vault files). All behind Depends(require_admin). Create admin Pydantic schemas: UserCreateAdmin, UserUpdateAdmin, UserListResponse, PasswordResetResponse.
task.verification: Admin can create users, reset passwords, change roles. Non-admin gets 403. Self-role-change blocked. Delete requires confirmation. Vault directory created on user creation.
task.done-condition: All 5 admin user endpoints functional behind require_admin, temp passwords generated correctly, vault directories created

plan.dependencies: PLAN-1-2 depends on PLAN-1-1 (needs app skeleton, models, migration, dependencies.py)
